updates.title: Boot works without git on Apollo
updates.summary: Host sync is skipped when .git is missing, credit-store packs are inlined into internetStore, and an emergency no-git console fix script can repair a broken zip-upload host.

updates.title: Self-heal missing credit-store on boot
updates.summary: Hosts without .git were crashing because lib/credit-store.js could not be restored. Boot now writes the missing credit-store files automatically, and pack data also lives under utils/creditStore.js.

updates.title: Host sync runs before bot imports
updates.summary: Fixed Apollo boot crashes when a tracked file like lib/credit-store.js was missing: index.js now force-syncs from main before loading Discord/bot modules, so the missing file can be restored.

updates.title: Pinellas welcome message with member count
updates.summary: Pinellas join welcomes now use the PCSO branding copy, a disabled member-count button, and an Information link button to the info channel.

updates.title: PCSO entry applications and clear status
updates.summary: Removed the Watching Clearwater Roleplay status. Added -apply (Administrator) to post the PCSO Components V2 entry panel, DM question flow, and staff approve/deny review with role assignment. Updated the Pinellas per-server avatar/banner branding.

updates.title: Animated Pinellas Operations avatar
updates.summary: The Pinellas per-server bot avatar is now an animated GIF of the sheriff badge with a subtle shine and glow loop.

updates.title: Pinellas Operations banner and bio
updates.summary: The Pinellas per-server bot profile now sets a PCSO collage banner and the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office operations bio, in addition to the nickname and badge avatar.

updates.title: Pinellas server logo refreshed (transparent)
updates.summary: Replaced the Pinellas Operations per-server avatar with the new five-point sheriff star badge on a transparent background.

updates.title: Pinellas Operations nickname, logo, and welcome
updates.summary: In the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office Discord, the bot sets its per-server nickname to Pinellas Operations and uses the PCSO badge as its server avatar. New joins get a welcome ping in the configured channel with a link to applications.

updates.title: Pause Roblox group sync when API account is moderated
updates.summary: When Roblox returns 403 User is moderated for the Open Cloud API key, group sync now posts one clear pause notice and waits 6 hours instead of spamming the log channel every minute. Fix by unmoderating that Roblox account or creating a new API key on an unmoderated account.

updates.title: Frequency Change greeting skips bot drags
updates.summary: If a bot (including Clearwater zone drag or another bot) moves someone into a Frequency Change VC, the bot no longer joins to play the welcome TTS. Manual joins by players still get the greeting when they are first in the channel.

updates.title: Clearer Spark/Apollo host repair steps
updates.summary: Added a noisy one-line Apollo console repair command and louder [host-sync] boot logs so stuck hosts show whether .git exists, fetch worked, and which commit is running. Still preserves data/ and .env.

updates.title: Spark/Apollo host sync keeps git login
updates.summary: Host code sync no longer replaces Apollo’s private-repo git remote with a public URL (which made fetch fail and kept old code). It preserves the panel token, force-syncs main, refreshes npm deps after updates, and leaves data/ + .env alone. Startup command can stay locked.

updates.title: Works with locked Apollopanel startup
updates.summary: You no longer need to change the panel startup command. index.js force-syncs code from main on boot while preserving data/ and .env, then restarts onto the new commit if needed. Do not wipe-and-reupload to update — just Restart (one-time console reset if still stuck on old code).

updates.title: Restart updates code without wiping data
updates.summary: start.sh now force-syncs bot code from main while preserving host-only data/ and .env. Do not delete-all and re-upload a zip to update — that wipes Clearwater Internet, salaries, and identity cache. Use Restart with bash start.sh.

updates.title: ER:LC zone voice logs to Discord
updates.summary: ER:LC map zone voice now posts enter/skip/error/heartbeat logs to channel 1514547037537046688 so staff can see whether the drag is running and why moves are skipped.

updates.title: ER:LC zone voice polls every 7s
updates.summary: The ER:LC map zone voice drag checker now polls player positions every 7 seconds instead of 10.

updates.title: ER:LC map zone voice drag
updates.summary: Players who enter the marked grassy map zone are moved into voice channel 1545525189339774997. Leaving the zone does nothing. Zone bounds are inset from surrounding roads.

updates.title: Secondary gate allowlist expanded
updates.summary: Main-server role 1536839307766267944 is now allowed through the secondary server gate.

updates.title: Locked post auto-deletes messages
updates.summary: Any message sent in Discord post/channel 1545828641999560824 is automatically deleted.

updates.title: Secondary gate uses REST role checks
updates.summary: Secondary server gate now verifies required main-server roles through Discord REST (not role cache), and the periodic mass sweep is disabled. Only confirmed missing-role members are kicked on join.

updates.title: Secondary gate no longer false-kicks
updates.summary: The secondary server gate now force-checks roles on the main Clearwater server and will not kick someone if role lookup fails. Only members confirmed missing roles 1514421440890409060 / 1514744040778760252 are removed from 1514189396184793169.

updates.title: Discord update log disabled
updates.summary: The bot no longer posts update announcements to a Discord channel, which removes the Unknown Channel error on startup.

updates.title: Host startup force-sync
updates.summary: Added start.sh so Apollopanel can force-reset to main before launch. This fixes the stuck old bot caused by a dirty downloads/rebuild-exe.sh blocking git pull.

updates.title: Secondary server role gate
updates.summary: Joining server 1514189396184793169 now requires role 1514744040778760252 or 1514421440890409060 in the main Clearwater Discord. Members without those roles are kicked, including a sweep of people already in that server.

updates.title: Update log channel moved
updates.summary: Bot update announcements now post to channel 1514547037537046688 (same channel as Hold VC action logs).

updates.title: Website removed — Discord bot only
updates.summary: The repository is now Discord-bot only. Website, Vercel, Phone, and the old HTTP bridge were removed. Hold VC action logs always post to channel 1514547037537046688.

updates.title: Clearwater Internet removed from website
updates.summary: The website no longer includes Clearwater Internet. Use Discord for community posts. Home, Departments, Docs, and Server Management stay on the site.

updates.title: Hold VC mutes faster
updates.summary: `-holdvc` now starts server-muting members as soon as the announcement begins and processes hold VC mutes/unmutes in parallel, so large voice chats lock and release much faster.

updates.title: Hold VC unmutes on channel move
updates.summary: `-holdvc` still server-mutes members who join the held voice channel, and now explicitly unserver-mutes them as soon as they leave that held channel or move into another voice channel.

updates.title: Cleaner Internet settings
updates.summary: The Discord Internet Settings card no longer shows empty Pronouns or Location rows.

updates.title: Internet post deletion permissions
updates.summary: Only a post's author or a Discord Administrator can use its Delete button. Deleting a forum post now removes the complete thread and its comments from the Internet channel.

updates.title: Discord Internet uploads and moderation
updates.summary: Clearwater Internet posts now accept image and GIF uploads from Discord, use the new Heart and chat emojis, and no longer show a report button. Automod holds go to a Discord staff review queue, and staff can use /internet panel to warn, mute, ban, or clear restrictions while affected users receive a DM.

updates.title: Clearwater Internet moves to Discord
updates.summary: The new Internet Panel in Discord lets members publish forum posts, like and comment, view profiles, report or delete posts, edit profile settings, and manage notification preferences without using the website.

updates.title: Motion on Home, Docs, and Wallet
updates.summary: Home, Departments, Docs, and Wallet now use Animate UI motion for titles, numbers, buttons, and scroll progress, still on the existing dark Clearwater look.

updates.title: Department weekly salaries
updates.summary: Ownership can configure department Discord servers, paid roles, and weekly Clearwater Credits payouts on a dedicated Owner panel Salaries tab. Eligible members see their stacked weekly pay on the Wallet Salary tab. Each department can pay different amounts per Discord role, and payouts also DM a wallet update.

updates.title: Discord emojis on Clearwater Internet
updates.summary: The emoji picker on Clearwater Internet now includes your Discord server's custom emojis. You can add them to posts and DMs, and they show as images in the feed.

updates.title: Hold VC mutes people who join
updates.summary: While `-holdvc` is active, anyone who joins the held voice channel is server-muted (Ownership skipped). Leaving the channel unmutes them again.

updates.title: Ownership can grant developer badge
updates.summary: Ownership can give or remove the Developer badge from the staff user panel. That badge unlocks full website permissions.

updates.title: Developer badge unlocks full site access
updates.summary: Accounts with the Developer badge now get every website permission: Owner Panel, staff tools, Server Management, and government access.

updates.title: Developer badge assigned
updates.summary: Added the Developer badge for Discord user 848356730256883744 on Clearwater Internet.

updates.title: Business logo URL preview fixed
updates.summary: Logo image URL now converts freeimage.host and Imgur page links into direct image links, shows a clear error when a link is not an image, and allows iili.io / Imgur images through the site security policy.

updates.title: Owner Panel only for owners
updates.summary: Owner Panel no longer uses the broken hidden attribute on the homepage menu. It stays invisible unless you are Ownership, then shows with a proper visibility class.

updates.title: GIF search fixed
updates.summary: Clearwater Internet GIF search works again. The Giphy endpoint was missing a cache helper import and failed every search.

updates.title: Hold VC is a prefix command again
updates.summary: Ownership hold VC is back on the dash prefix: `-holdvc` and `-unholdvc` (slash `/holdvc` / `/unholdvc` removed).

updates.title: Phone launcher uses setup and the Clearwater logo
updates.summary: Opening Clearwater Phone now always starts with Discord, Z Phone or X Phone, wallpaper, and settings. The launcher uses the Clearwater logo instead of the old anchor mark.

updates.title: Phone setup, maps, and home bar
updates.summary: First launch now requires Discord, then Z Phone (Samsung) or X Phone (Apple), wallpaper colors that actually tint the home screen, and the same startup and shortcut settings as Settings. Maps no longer shows extra road lines or a squished county map. The bottom bar closes the current app, and Find My pans and zooms like Maps.

updates.title: Phone first-launch customize
updates.summary: Opening Clearwater Phone for the first time now goes Sign in → pick Z Phone (Samsung) or X Phone (Apple) → choose a wallpaper color, then launches.

updates.title: Phone installs as a Windows app
updates.summary: Download Phone now installs Clearwater Phone like a normal Windows app (Start Menu and desktop shortcut). After setup you can delete the downloaded installer. Quit the old tray app first if Windows will not let you delete the previous .exe.

updates.title: Bigger Find My map
updates.summary: The Find My map in Clearwater Phone now fills most of the screen instead of a small preview.

updates.title: Maps reroutes and Find My search
updates.summary: Phone Maps recalculates the road path if you go off route. Find My now has a name search and Discord profile pictures on the list and map.

updates.title: Phone Messages matches Internet
updates.summary: Inside Phone Internet, Wallet and Messages are hidden because those are their own Phone apps. The Messages app now opens the same inbox as the website Messages tab.

updates.title: Edit business profile only for managers
updates.summary: The Edit business profile button no longer shows on every member page. It only appears on a business account you actually manage.

updates.title: Phone Maps follows roads
updates.summary: Start route now navigates along painted Liberty County roads. Management can draw those roads on Server Management, Phone Maps zooms like Google Maps, and your in-game pin updates about every two seconds.

updates.title: Phone home tagline removed
updates.summary: The Clearwater Phone home screen no longer shows the Internet / Roleplay Panel line under the logo.

updates.title: Phone Internet is the real mobile site
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone now opens the full mobile Internet app with profile pictures, scrollable Maps without the extra background, tighter text, and the Windows app name Clearwater Phone instead of Electron.

updates.title: Phone overlay and apps restored
updates.summary: The Phone start screen is a normal window again instead of a black fullscreen, and Messages/Find My talk to Clearwater through the signed-in browser session.

updates.title: Internet page script fix
updates.summary: Removed leftover merge conflict markers at the bottom of Clearwater Internet so the page scripts load cleanly again.

updates.title: Phone API connection fixed
updates.summary: Messages, Find My, Wallet, and Maps no longer fail with a Chromium network error. The overlay now talks to Clearwater through a normal HTTPS request.

updates.title: Staff, business logos, tips, and Phone updates
updates.summary: Ships remove-warning in staff, business logo URLs + idle purge, newest tip in For You, Phone outdated popup, and Clearwater logo on Phone home (v1.3.12).

updates.title: Phone apps work after sign-in
updates.summary: Messages, Find My, Wallet, and Maps can talk to Clearwater again. Sign-in was sticking, but the overlay never had a working API connection.

updates.title: Remove individual warnings in staff
updates.summary: The staff Users panel Warnings list now has a Remove button on each warning or staff notice. Removals can be restored from moderation history.

updates.title: Staff can delete business accounts
updates.summary: In the staff Users panel, business accounts now have a Delete business account action. It removes the business, its posts, and its ads. The linked personal handler account stays.

updates.title: Custom banner uploads removed
updates.summary: Profile banners can no longer be uploaded while Vercel Blob storage is full. Pick a Clearwater scene preset, or remove your banner.

updates.title: Tipped posts rotate in For You
updates.summary: Paid For You tips now show one tipped post at a time. Which tip appears is random, and it switches between the 1st and 2nd feed slots instead of always sitting on top.

updates.title: Phone setup stays open
updates.summary: The first-launch menu no longer closes on its own after a few seconds, and the extra outline around the phone overlay is gone.

updates.title: Government nav hidden without roles
updates.summary: The Government link stays completely hidden unless your Discord roles allow government tools — same behavior as Staff.

updates.title: VPN allowlist for one member
updates.summary: One Discord account is allowed to use Clearwater while on a VPN. Everyone else is still blocked from VPN/proxy connections.

updates.title: Phone stays signed in
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone no longer flashes “Signed in” then immediately signs you out. Discord login is kept until you tap Sign out.

updates.title: Staff PIN fully removed
updates.summary: Ownership and Management open the staff desk with their Discord role only. Leftover PIN code, cookies, and settings notes are gone.

updates.title: @mentions and #hashtags show in blue
updates.summary: In Clearwater Internet posts, @handles and #tags are highlighted in blue again so they stand out from regular text.

updates.title: Fewer API requests, quieter status
updates.summary: Homepage and Internet poll far less often. Status APIs are cached server-side, blocked from casual browser tabs, and heartbeats no longer spam separate presence and warning calls.

updates.title: VPNs and proxies are blocked
updates.summary: Clearwater sign-in and Internet now reject VPN and proxy connections. Turn the VPN off, then try again. Detection is cached server-side so open tabs do not spam lookup services.

updates.title: Government tab and credit fines
updates.summary: A Government tab sits under Settings for the government Discord role. Members can request Clearwater Credit fines, reviewers can approve or deny them, unpaid balances go into debt until later credits pay them down, and actions log to the government Discord channel. Update log posts now include a timestamp.

updates.title: Phone overlay no longer ghosts
updates.summary: The overlay window is opaque, inactive screens stay hidden, and first-time setup no longer stacks overlapping cards or leftover welcome text.

updates.title: Phone Discord sign-in actually sticks
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone now keeps a Discord session the overlay can read. Signing in no longer depends on cookies the desktop app could not see.

updates.title: Phone setup stays on screen
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone keeps the first-launch setup and Launch Phone screens open until you finish. Opening Roblox no longer closes that window.

updates.title: Staff switches keep the side you click
updates.summary: Staff panel on/off switches no longer snap the other way after you click. Saves are protected from background refresh, and a stuck switch now tells you to restart the bot host if needed.

updates.title: Staff ban toggle stays on
updates.summary: Banning someone from the staff panel now keeps the Banned switch on. Ban, mute, and lock actions were writing to a discarded user record and looked like they flipped back off.

updates.title: Internet load cut back
updates.summary: Clearwater Internet no longer reloads the feed, images, and status every few seconds. Likes wait a beat before saving, and rapid like-tapping is rate limited so it cannot stall the server.

updates.title: Phone icons and update notice
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone home icons now match the website (with a new Find My icon). If your phone is out of date, it shows a notice with a link to download the latest build.

updates.title: Poll votes update in place
updates.summary: Voting on a poll no longer reloads the whole Internet feed from /api/internet. The post updates from the vote response instead.

updates.title: Internet API hidden from browser tabs
updates.summary: Opening /api/internet in a browser now returns Not found instead of feed JSON or API error text. The Internet app and Phone still load the feed normally.

updates.title: Staff panel opens without a PIN
updates.summary: Staff with Discord panel access can open the Clearwater Staff desk directly. The ownership and management PIN gate is removed.

updates.title: Homepage status strip cleaned up
updates.summary: Removed the green live indicator and Discord bot latency line from the homepage. Player count and queue still update live.

updates.title: Phone Discord sign-in and setup stay put
updates.summary: Signing in with Discord now copies the session into the overlay instead of only showing a signed-in popup. First-time setup also stays open until you finish, instead of flashing away if Roblox is already running.

updates.title: Phone first-time setup is back
updates.summary: The first time you open Clearwater Phone, you get a setup page to sign in with Discord and choose startup preferences before launching the overlay.

updates.title: Phone sign-in no longer opens the feed
updates.summary: Discord login on Clearwater Phone now returns to the overlay instead of leaving you on the Internet feed in the popup, and the phone stays signed in.

updates.title: Phone Discord sign-in works
updates.summary: Signing in with Discord on Clearwater Phone now keeps you signed in on the overlay so Wallet, Messages, and Internet load your real account.

updates.title: Phone launcher, Internet app, and download
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone opens to a full-screen intro until you click Launch Phone. The overlay now has an Internet app for posting to the live feed, plus settings to start with Windows and auto-launch when Roblox opens. Download Phone is back on the Internet sidebar.

updates.title: Phone overlay uses live Internet
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone now signs in with Discord and uses your real Wallet (transactions, send, request) and Messages. Maps uses the ER:LC map so you can tap a destination and route from your in-game location. Find My shares that location with friends you choose. Marketplace is removed from the overlay.

updates.title: Moderation help cleanup
updates.summary: Removed the “Modeled after Circle-style staff tools” footer from `-help` so the command embed stays clean.

updates.title: Discord update logging
updates.summary: Site and bot changes are now logged to this channel. New updates are queued in the repo and posted automatically when the bot starts (or immediately via the bot API).

updates.title: Update log shows who updated
updates.summary: Discord update log embeds now include an “Updated by” field naming who requested or owns each change.

updates.title: Rank-locked moderation commands
updates.summary: Prefix moderation commands are now locked by staff rank: any staff can warn/mute; Administrator+ can kick; Supervisor+ can ban/softban/unban and lock channels; Lead Moderator+ can purge; Senior Supervisor+ can clear modlogs (`-uwid`).

updates.title: Update log uses git username
updates.summary: “Updated by” in the Discord update log now uses the git/GitHub username (e.g. colin991) instead of a full name.

updates.title: Hold VC command
updates.summary: Added Ownership-only `-holdvc` / `-unholdvc` (not part of the staff moderation command list): server-mutes everyone in a voice channel except Ownership, announces “Please Hold this voice chat”, and plays a bundled voice announcement in the channel (no API key).

updates.title: Hold VC is Ownership-only
updates.summary: `-holdvc` / `-unholdvc` are restricted to Ownership and removed from the staff moderation help list.

updates.title: Hold VC joins and speaks in channel
updates.summary: `-holdvc` now joins the voice channel and plays a bundled hold announcement for everyone in VC (no API key, no Discord text TTS). The bot stays in the channel until `-unholdvc`.

updates.title: Hold VC no longer needs OpenAI
updates.summary: `-holdvc` plays a bundled `assets/hold-vc.mp3` announcement in the voice channel. No OpenAI API key is required.

updates.title: Hold VC is a slash command
updates.summary: Moved hold VC off the `-` prefix toolkit to normal Discord slash commands: `/holdvc` and `/unholdvc` (Ownership only).

updates.title: Say command for voice chat
updates.summary: Added Ownership-only `/say text:` — the bot joins a voice channel and speaks the given text for everyone (no API key).

updates.title: VC action logging
updates.summary: Ownership VC commands (`/say`, `/holdvc`, `/unholdvc`) now post who used them and what happened to Discord channel 1538021552120135731.

updates.title: Roblox group sync retries
updates.summary: Roblox group join-request sync now retries on temporary API failures (like 502) and rate-limits Discord error alerts for those outages.

updates.title: Transparent logo icons
updates.summary: Rebuilt app/home screen icons (192, 512, apple-touch) from the Clearwater logo with a transparent background instead of the dark square fill.

updates.title: Sidebar ad matches site chrome
updates.summary: Sponsored sidebar ads match the solid card surface of What’s happening / Who to follow, and the right rail is a fixed-height independently scrollable column.

updates.title: Notice channel auto-moderation
updates.summary: The no-message notice stays in channel 1515038785421836479 (plain # Notice), links to verification channel 1514181167145025666, increments +1 on every deleted post, auto-timeouts for 7 days, re-sends if deleted, and can be force-refreshed with `-noticerefresh`.

updates.title: Staff Active users tab
updates.summary: The staff panel Active tab lists logged-in members currently on Clearwater Internet (especially the home feed), using live presence pulses with Discord avatar, display name, @username, and Discord ID.

updates.title: Reels photo load fix
updates.summary: Fixed intermittent Reel “photo could not be loaded” errors: same-origin /api/media now proxies Vercel Blob bytes instead of 302ing into a CSP-blocked *.public.blob host, with retries and CSP allowlist updates for large media fallbacks.

updates.title: Business profile editing
updates.summary: Handlers and managers can update an approved business account’s logo, name, type, and about text from Settings → Account (or Edit business profile on the business page).

updates.title: Sponsored ad copy visible again
updates.summary: Sidebar sponsored cards again show body text and Learn/Account buttons: overflow clipping on the right rail was fixed and button/copy contrast was restored against the charcoal card surface.

updates.title: Community pauses contrast
updates.summary: Staff Controls community pause toggles no longer inherit the solid accent button fill, so labels like “Open to members” stay readable on the charcoal panel.

updates.title: Void command and V2 embeds
updates.summary: Renamed `-uwid` to `-void` (old alias still works). Bot replies and logs now use Discord Components V2 containers with no left accent bar color instead of classic embeds.

updates.title: Reel video playback fix
updates.summary: Reel videos now redirect to blob storage for streaming with HTTP Range support instead of being fully buffered by the media proxy, which had been causing black frames and “cannot play here” errors.

updates.title: Staff notice and warning popups
updates.summary: Staff notices now open the on-site alert modal (same as warnings), and unread warnings/notices are checked every few seconds so members already on Clearwater Internet see them without refreshing.

updates.title: Scrollable Internet right rail
updates.summary: The home-page right column (What’s happening, ads, Who to follow) stays sticky and scrolls on its own when the widgets are taller than the viewport.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone overlay
updates.summary: New downloadable Clearwater Phone desktop overlay (Electron) with original icons and wallpaper for Wallet, Marketplace, Find My, Mail, Messages, and Maps. Always-on-top; toggle with F8.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone download on Internet
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone is available from Internet → Phone (and the sidebar card). Download ClearwaterPhone.zip, extract, and run ClearwaterPhone-Launch.bat.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone download more visible
updates.summary: Added a Download for Windows banner on the Internet home feed and a Download Phone button in the left rail so the overlay zip is easy to find.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone Windows exe
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone download is now a single ClearwaterPhone.exe — double-click to open. First launch installs the runtime once automatically.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone portable app
updates.summary: Replaced the console runtime-downloader with a real portable ClearwaterPhone.exe that opens the overlay directly (no black window, no separate download). Windows SmartScreen may still warn once because the app is unsigned — use More info → Run anyway.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone theme cleanup
updates.summary: Removed the home/sidebar Phone promo cards, restyled Phone download buttons to Clearwater Internet colors, and updated the overlay app UI to the charcoal + blue theme.

updates.title: Marketplace, Mail, and premium Phone
updates.summary: Added Marketplace and Mail to Clearwater Internet. Clearwater Phone overlay was redesigned and each app can open the matching website page.

updates.title: Phone settings and auto-update
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone Settings can open apps on Clearwater Internet. The overlay checks for updates, shows an outdated banner, and can auto-download the latest ClearwaterPhone.exe.

updates.title: Clearwater Phone app icon
updates.summary: ClearwaterPhone.exe now uses the Clearwater server logo as the Windows app/taskbar icon.

updates.title: Mail removed
updates.summary: Removed Mail from Clearwater Phone (v1.1.2). Mail was already removed from Clearwater Internet navigation.

updates.title: Phone home uses Clearwater logo
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone home wallpaper now shows the Clearwater logo instead of the old anchor mark. Phone v1.1.3.

updates.title: Pinned post setting removed
updates.summary: Removed the Pinned post dropdown from profile settings. Profiles no longer lift a pinned post to the top.

updates.title: Phone Discord sign-in hardened
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone Discord login now uses a normal browser user-agent, keeps OAuth popups in the same session, and polls until the account sticks (v1.3.2).

updates.title: Phone show-button setting
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone Settings has a Show phone section where you can change the keyboard button that shows or hides the overlay (v1.3.3).

updates.title: Phone updater fixed
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone updates now download with a real browser session, verify the exe file, replace the running app on Windows after quit, and open the download page if Cloudflare blocks the file (v1.3.4).

updates.title: Server Management Load button
updates.summary: Server Management now has a Load action that runs :load on players selected on the map.

updates.title: Business logos use image URLs
updates.summary: Business logos are set with a public https image link instead of file upload. Active business handlers get an inbox notice to update theirs. The Tipped badge is now a flat single color.

updates.title: Business logos + idle cleanup
updates.summary: Vercel Blob is reserved for business logos under 2 MB. Business accounts unused for a week are removed automatically, and their logos are deleted from storage.

updates.title: Newest tip leads For You
updates.summary: The tipped post shown in the 1st or 2nd For You slot is now always the most recently tipped one, still rotating between those two positions.

updates.title: Phone outdated version popup
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone now pops up when you are on an older build and offers Download v1.3.11 (or whichever version is current).

updates.title: Phone home uses Clearwater logo
updates.summary: Clearwater Phone’s home wallpaper now shows the Clearwater logo instead of the old anchor mark. Download Phone v1.3.11 to get it.

updates.title: Discord Internet Panel startup hotfix
updates.summary: Fixed the Discord bot startup import so the Clearwater Internet Panel and weekly department salary service can load together after deployment.
